fixes.explanation: Judge's seat? Friend, I looked all over this passage and found NO gavel. Not one. This is a different job. The LORD tells Moses, Israel's leader, to clothe Aaron, Moses' brother (Exodus 4:14), and anoint him and consecrate him “…so that he may serve Me as a priest.” Priest is the role here, and I think Aaron's already got plenty on his plate.

Good guess, friend, because offerings do show up in this chapter. In verse 29, Moses offers the burnt offering and the grain offering on the altar. But the lifting cloud is a different signal. The text says, “Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out through all the stages of their journey.” So when the cloud lifts, the people set out.

Ha! A meeting with Moses sounds like a fine plan, friend, but these verses don't call one. The cloud is the signal, and the people watch it like a kitchen timer they can't ignore. When it lifts, they set out (Exodus 40:36). If it doesn't lift, “they would not set out until the day it was taken up.” And everybody can see it, because verse 38 says the cloud was “in the sight of all the house of Israel through all their journeys.”
